game_concept: A speed quiz set in Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge, a ridge known for yetis: the ice axe ranger must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Nested Registry: Navigate dictionaries inside dictionaries to find the right record.
theme: Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge: a ridge known for yetis
core_gameplay_loop: In Yeti Ridge, repeat each round: Navigate dictionaries inside dictionaries to find the right record. Each round, a new flares challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the registry value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of flares by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Nested Registry
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested Registry' (Week 8 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Yeti Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how registry changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Yeti Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
